## Summary
The schema is single-tenant: MRN is globally unique and no query filters by clinic. Add `tenant_id`, scope every finder, and bind users to a tenant.

## Findings
| id | severity | category | location | evidence | recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ARC-001 | high | data | sample-app/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql:11 | `uq_patient_mrn UNIQUE (mrn)`: two clinics issuing the same MRN collide | New migration: add `tenant_id` to patient and observation; replace with `UNIQUE (tenant_id, mrn)`. |
| ARC-002 | high | security | sample-app/src/main/java/org/example/fhir/repository/PatientRepository.java:10 | `findByMrn` and `existsByMrn` are global, so a clinic could read another clinic's patient | Tenant-scoped methods (`findByTenantIdAndMrn`); no unscoped finder remains. |
| ARC-003 | medium | security | sample-app/src/main/java/org/example/fhir/config/SecurityConfig.java:62 | Users in SecurityConfig carry no tenant | Bind each user to a tenant (claim or user attribute) and derive the tenant from the principal, never from a request parameter. |

## Decisions
- Draft ADR-0002: shared schema with `tenant_id` (chosen) vs schema-per-tenant (rejected: Flyway runs per schema, harder cross-clinic ops).
